inputSchema.description: Request schema for updating the position of a member's starred board.

idBoardStar.description: The unique identifier of the specific board star whose position is to be changed. Each board starred by a member has a unique `idBoardStar`.
idBoardStar.title: Id Board Star

idMember.description: The ID or username of the Trello member. The special value 'me' can be used to refer to the currently authenticated user.
idMember.title: Id Member

value.description: The new position for the starred board. Valid inputs are the literal strings 'top', 'bottom', or a string representing a positive number (e.g., '1', '2.5', '10').
value.title: Value

id.description: Unique identifier for the board star. TrelloID format: 24-character hexadecimal string.
id.title: Id

idBoard.description: The ID of the board that is starred. TrelloID format: 24-character hexadecimal string.
idBoard.title: Id Board

pos.description: Position of the starred board in the user's starred boards list. Used for ordering starred boards.
pos.title: Pos
